item.summary: fix(telegram): resolve General topic session lanes from the cached forum flag (#126656) Use the cached Telegram forum flag to keep General-topic updates on their `topic:1` session lane during admission and durable-row reconciliation. This prevents the session-init retry loop while preserving explicit forum hints. Co-authored-by: datenpapst Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
